summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by NatWest Group plc to disclose PDMR share acquisitions under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. The filing reports that directors purchased shares on May 5, 2026, via dividend reinvestment at £5.5616 per share. No M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or other special situation is involved. The transactions are normal insider holdings adjustments, not an event-driven catalyst. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural changes. As a foreign private issuer routine disclosure, it does not map to any U.S. special-situation category.
